title: Maintaining Trap Seals to Block Sewer Gas
description: Drain traps are engineered to hold a standing pocket of water that acts as a continuous liquid barrier, preventing sewer gases, foul odors, and pests from entering living spaces. However, unvented siphoning, excessive pressure fluctuations, or long-term evaporation can empty this trap seal. When a fixture goes unused for extended periods, the standing water gradually evaporates, breaking the protective barrier. Professional plumbers prevent dry traps by ensuring proper fixture venting during installation and advising property owners to routinely run water down seldom-used drains to maintain a full water seal.
